captions_note: the words of the effect are the palette card's codes and labels; it sits beside the face, the reel's captions run under it
in_a_reel: ON is the word the grade starts to fall on. The card and the taps come 0.6 s before it, so start the slot at least 0.7 s before that word
OUT = 'auto' unless the slot ends on a cut of the reel. Set TITLE and LABELS in the reel's language, and the STYLE block from the reel's caption style
steps: edit ON, TITLE and LABELS in the CLIP block
run build.py SAFE=1      # measures five colours off the clip, bakes the three grade steps, prints them
run check.py      # frame count, plain first frame, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
